headline: Zhipu AI's GLM hits the top—and breaks records doing it
summary: Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash just claimed the #1 spot with 11.5% token share, marking both an all-time high and the model's first time at the podium. DeepSeek and OpenAI hold firm in the top three, but the real story is Zhipu's provider-level surge: up 1.5 points overnight and 11.8 points in a week. Meanwhile, MiniMax's free tier is on day 5 of its all-time token-share streak at 5.6%.
